definitions.evaluated_hosts: hosts with at least one compromised (user/root) label in the split; def is never compromised and user0 (Red foothold) is not a label host, so 11 hosts are evaluated
definitions.pooled: confusion summed over evaluated hosts and all host-steps
definitions.host_avg_f1: per-class F1 averaged over the evaluated hosts in which the class occurs
definitions.spell: maximal run of consecutive steps with y > 0 on one host; latency = steps from spell onset to the first prediction > 0 (breach) or to the first prediction equal to the true class (exact)
